violations.text: Packages of crushed cracker were observed with rodent gnawing/residue/droppings. Packages were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings observed on shelving in the dry storage room and bags of crushed cracker with evidence of rodent adulteration (gnawing/droppings/residue). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Per the PIC, pest control currently inspects biweekly with next inspection due within days from date of this inspection (latest report reviewed). PIC is to ensure the following: - Once removed from packaging, all food items are stored in a manner to protect food/food packaging from rodent adulteration - Single use items are maintained in packaging to protect from possible rodent contamination - Any prep surfaces/food contact surfaces are to be properly sanitized prior to use - Flooring and shelving affected by rodent activity is to be properly cleaned as soon as possible upon observation - Search for any gaps/possible entry points and properly seal them to prevent entry of rodents/pests - Activity log is maintained for pest tech awareness New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Doors to the outside in the back area and utility room area were observed with gaps allowing for possible rodent entry. Outer openings are to be maintained properly sealed and protected to prevent entry of pests. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Flooring and Shelving in the dry storage area were observed with debris and droppings. Facilities are to be cleaned at a frequency necessary to keep them clean and to aid in the current pest control program. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

The Food Safety Manager License registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection is currently expired in must be reinstated as soon as possible. Application printed and left with PIC at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2025
The ceiling of the cookline side of the kitchen was observed to have a chipped/cracked surface coating and is need of repair. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2026

Deli Meat(s) were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Per the PIC, deli meats are sliced for a week at a time. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
The tiles on the floor of the cookline area are in poor repair (Chipped/Cracked). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024
The tiles on the floor of the cookline area is in poor repair (Chipped/Cracked). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024

The Open Air Cooler located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Unit was observed to be maintaining an ambient temperature of 56 degrees Fahrenheit at the time of inspection. Unit is to be repaired/adjusted. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2024

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3 bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. Pre-flush sprayer is to be adjusted. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2024
The tiles on the floor of the cookline area is in poor repair (Chipped/Cracked). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2024
